seo.title: Restaurant Menu Maker – Printable Menus from Your Dishes
seo.description: Paste your dishes and prices and get a designed one-page restaurant menu. Download a print-ready Letter or A4 PDF with bleed, plus an image for your website.
intro: Paste your menu the way you'd write it on a notepad: one dish per line with a short description and price. PiCraft lays it out as a finished, printable menu.
Choose US Letter or A4, download the PDF for your printer, and use the web image on your website, Google Business Profile or delivery apps.

prompt:
Design a one-page printable restaurant menu in portrait orientation, shown flat and front-on, filling the whole image edge to edge. It is the artwork itself, not a mockup: no table, no hands, no drop shadow.
Style: {{style}}.
At the top, the restaurant name "{{restaurantName}}"[[ with the tagline "{{cuisine}}"]].
Below it, list these menu lines in a clean, well-aligned layout. Keep the order, names, descriptions and prices exactly as written; dish names prominent, descriptions smaller, prices aligned consistently. Lines without a price are section headings:
{{items}}
All text spelled exactly as provided and perfectly legible. Do not invent dishes, prices or extra text. Keep all text at least 6% away from every edge. Print-quality.

faq.q: How many items can a menu have?
faq.a: Up to 14 lines, which keeps the text large enough to read and accurate. For longer menus, create one page per section.
The model is instructed to copy every name and price as written, but always proofread. Generate again if a line is off.

faq.q: Can I use it for cafés, bars and food trucks?
faq.a: Yes. Use the tagline to describe the place, and choose the street food style for trucks and casual spots.
No. The restaurant name is set as a typographic logo in the chosen style.

faq.q: What format should I paste my menu in?
faq.a: One dish per line, for example: Margherita – tomato, fior di latte, basil – $14. Lines without a price become section headings.

faq.q: Can I change a price after generating?
faq.a: The text is part of the image, so generate again with the corrected line. Keep your menu text saved so it takes a minute.

faq.q: Which paper size should I choose?
faq.a: Choose US Letter in the US and Canada and A4 in most other countries. Each download includes the right bleed for that size.

faq.q: Can I use it for a drinks menu?
faq.a: Yes. List drinks the same way, one per line with a price.
Many places must show allergen notes on menus. PiCraft doesn't add them, so include them in your lines or add them in your printer's editor.
